name: Mary Doyle's Testimony
description: Mary Doyle, a resident of Whitmore Street, confirms that the roof of number twelve collapsed last winter, killing a child. Councillor Hargrove paid the family to remain silent. Clara Hale had been collecting signed testimonies from residents — at least four people have spoken to her.
journal_entry: Clara had testimonies from four witnesses. She sent them to the Chronicle. Arthur buried the story.
